Samsonite International S.A.
新秀麗國際有限公司
Stock Code 股份代號 1910




       RAVEL
        IS BACK




                                     2022
                               Annual Report 年報
We are pleased with Samsonite’s progress in 2022. With the continued easing of pandemic-related
restrictions, there has been a strong recovery in travel across most of our markets globally, enabling
the Group to achieve strong results for the year ended December 31, 2022, and positioning the
business for sustained revenue and earnings growth going forward.

我們對新秀麗於2022年取得的進展感到欣慰。隨着疫情相關限制持續放寬，全球大部分市場的旅遊業均
強勁復甦，使本集團截至2022年12月31日止年度實現強勁的業績，並為業務未來的持續收入及盈利增長
打好基礎。




Timothy Charles Parker
Chairman 主席

Corporate Profile                                                              公司簡介
With a heritage dating back more than 110 years, Samsonite                     新秀麗國際有限公司（「本公司」，連同其綜合
International S.A. (the “Company”), together with its consolidated             附屬公司統稱為「本集團」）擁有逾 110 年悠久
subsidiaries (the “Group”), is a leader in the global lifestyle bag industry   歷史，是全球時尚箱包行業的翹楚，並且是全
and is the world’s best-known and largest travel luggage company.              球最著名、規模最大的行李箱公司。本集團主
The Group is principally engaged in the design, manufacture, sourcing          要在全球從事設計、製造、採購及分銷行李
and distribution of luggage, business and computer bags, outdoor and           箱、商務包及電腦包、戶外包及休閒包以及旅
casual bags and travel accessories throughout the world, primarily             遊配件，旗下品牌主要包括新秀麗 ®、Tumi ®、
under the Samsonite ®, Tumi ®, American Tourister ®, Gregory ®, High           A m e r i c a n T o u r i s t e r ® 、G r e g o r y ® 、H i g h
Sierra , Kamiliant , ebags , Lipault
      ®             ®       ®          ®
                                           and Hartmann   ®
                                                              brand names as   S i e r r a ® 、K a m i l i a n t ® 、e b a g s ® 、L i p a u l t ® 及
well as other owned and licensed brand names.                                  Hartmann ® 品牌以及其他自有及獲授權的品牌。


The Company’s Culture and Strategy                                             本公司的文化及策略
The principal characteristics of the Company’s culture are:                    本公司文化的主要特點是：


•   The Company’s long-standing guiding principle, the Golden Rule,            •    本公司一直以來的指導原則以「己所不欲，
    to “do unto others as you would have them do unto you,” is a                    勿施於人」為黃金法則，這是本集團創始人
    legacy of the Group’s founder and guides relationships between                  的遺訓，指導着本集團員工之間以及與客
    the Group’s employees and with its customers, vendors, and other                戶、供應商和其他持份者的關係。
    stakeholders.


•   The Group’s decentralized management model empowers                        •    本集團的分權管理模式為團隊賦能，同時
    teams and fosters an entrepreneurial, innovative approach to the                鼓勵合作共享最佳實踐，促進以創業且創
    business while encouraging collaboration to share best practices.               新的精神經營業務。


•   The Group’s lean organizational structure encourages efficient,            •    本集團的精簡組織架構鼓勵高效、及時的
    timely decision-making and transparency, and minimizes corporate                決策和透明度，並儘量減少企業的官僚主
    bureaucracy.                                                                    義。


•   The Group’s employees have a shared commitment to acting                   •    本集團的員工共同承諾，將按照本公司的
    lawfully, ethically and responsibly in keeping with the Company’s               行為守則合法、合道德和負責任地行事，
    code of conduct, which is communicated to employees throughout                  該守則每年都會向整個集團的員工傳達。
    the Group on an annual basis.


•   Coming out of the COVID-19 pandemic, the Group has renewed                 •    自2019 冠狀病毒疫症恢復後，本集團重新
    its focus on its culture and its diversity and inclusion initiatives.           關注其文化及其多樣性及包容性措施。


•   The Group has made a concerted effort to foster employee                   •    於截至2022年12月31日止年度，本集團通
    engagement through a global survey and focus groups during the                  過全球調查和焦點小組，攜手促進員工參
    year ended December 31, 2022, and with the recent appointment                   與度，並在近期任命公司的首位全球員工
    of the Company’s first Global Head of Employee Experience.                      體驗主管。


•   Employees’ shared commitment to the Company’s “Our                         •    員工對本公司「負責任之旅」可持續發展倡
    Responsible Journey” sustainability initiatives.                                議作出共同承諾。


The Company believes that its culture is critical to the successful            本公司認為公司文化對成功執行策略至關重
execution of its strategies, and well aligned with such strategies.            要，並與有關策略配合接軌。

    consumers at all price points in both the travel and non-travel            非旅遊行李箱、箱包及配件類別所有價格
    luggage, bag and accessories categories.                                   點的消費者。

    consumer e-commerce channel.                                               佔銷售淨額的比重。

    brands and initiatives.                                                    展方案。

    structure, distribution expertise and marketing engine to extend           長以及營銷動力，將其品牌拓展至新市
    its brands into new markets and penetrate deeper into existing             場，並加深滲透現有渠道。
    channels.

    and stronger new materials, advanced manufacturing processes,              更堅固的新物料、先進的製造技術、具吸

    innovative functionalities that deliver real benefits to consumers.        及為消費者帶來實際效益的創新功能。

    strategic functions to support its continued sales growth.               資，以支持其銷售額持續增長。

     度，於北美洲的銷售淨額較去年增加342.8百萬美元或44.3%（按不變匯率基準計算則增加44.6%）。

     subsequently completed the disposition of its Russian operations on July 1, 2022. When excluding the Russia Net Sales for the second
     quarter of 2022 and the second, third and fourth quarters of 2021, net sales in Europe increased by US$288.2 million, or 74.8% (+103.6%
     constant currency), for the year ended December 31, 2022, compared to the previous year.
     由於烏克蘭出現武裝衝突，本集團於2022年3月14日暫停在俄羅斯的所有商業活動，且本集團隨後於2022年7月1日完成出售其俄羅斯業務。
     經撇除於2022年第二季度及2021年第二季度、第三季度及第四季度的俄羅斯銷售淨額，截至2022年12月31日止年度歐洲的銷售淨額較去年
     增加288.2百萬美元或74.8%（按不變匯率基準計算則增加103.6%）。

     currency), for the year ended December 31, 2022, compared to the previous year.
     經撇除俄羅斯及Speck的銷售淨額，截至2022年12月31日止年度的綜合銷售淨額較去年增加923.5百萬美元或47.3%（按不變匯率基準計算則

REGIONS
North America
The Group’s net sales in North America increased by
US$309.8 million, or 38.4% (+38.7% constant currency), for     NORTH
the year ended December 31, 2022, compared to the year
ended December 31, 2021, due to relaxed social-distancing      AMERICA
                                                               北美洲
restrictions, markets reopening and travel continuing to
rebound in both the United States and Canada. On July
30, 2021, a wholly-owned subsidiary of the Company sold
Speck. Excluding the Speck Net Sales for January through
July 2021, net sales in North America increased by US$342.8
million, or 44.3% (+44.6% constant currency), for the year
ended December 31, 2022, compared to the previous year.

The Group’s net sales declined by 18.0% (-18.1% constant
currency) in North America during the year ended December
31, 2022, compared to the year ended December 31, 2019.
When excluding the Speck Net Sales for January through
December 2019, net sales in North America decreased by
9.9% (-9.9% constant currency) for the year ended December
31, 2022, compared to the year ended December 31, 2019.

The Group’s net sales performance in North America
continued to improve during the first two months of 2023,
compared to 2022 and 2019. Net sales in North America for
the first two months of 2023 increased by 37.5% (+37.9%
constant currency) compared to the first two months of 2022,
and decreased by 6.8% (-6.7% constant currency) compared
to the first two months of 2019. When excluding the Speck
Net Sales for January and February 2019, net sales increased
by 3.1% (+3.1% constant currency) for the first two months
of 2023 compared to the first two months of 2019.


地區

REGIONS
Asia
The Group’s net sales in Asia increased by US$228.9 million,
or 33.3% (+43.9% constant currency), for the year ended               ASIA
                                                                      亞洲
December 31, 2022, compared to the year ended December
31, 2021. When excluding the Group’s net sales in China
for the second, third and fourth quarters of 2022 and 2021,
the Group’s net sales in Asia for the year ended December
31, 2022, increased by US$285.1 million, or 55.8% (+68.5%
constant currency), when compared to the previous year.
While the tightening of travel restrictions and social distancing
measures slowed the net sales recovery in China during
the second, third and fourth quarters of 2022, the net sales
performance in other countries within Asia continued to
improve.

The Group’s net sales declined by 30.2% (-25.0% constant
currency) in Asia during the year ended December 31, 2022,
compared to the year ended December 31, 2019. When
excluding the Group’s net sales in China for the second, third                                            Samsonite Red
and fourth quarters of 2022 and 2019, the Group’s net sales                                               TOIIS C
in Asia for the year ended December 31, 2022, decreased
by 26.0% (-19.5% constant currency) when compared to the
year ended December 31, 2019.

The Group’s net sales performance in Asia continued to
improve during the first two months of 2023. Net sales for
the first two months of 2023 increased by 74.4% and by 3.2%
(+85.9% and +12.0% constant currency) compared to the first two
months of 2022 and 2019, respectively. When excluding the Group’s
net sales in China for the first two months of 2023, 2022 and 2019, net
sales for the first two months of 2023 increased by 99.4% and by 10.0% (+112.1%
and +21.1% constant currency) compared to the first two months of 2022 and 2019, respectively, driven by the
continued rebound in travel in Asian markets outside China. The Group’s net sales performance in China also improved
as the Chinese government discontinued its zero-COVID policy and relaxed travel and social-distancing restrictions. Net
sales in China for the first two months of 2023 increased by 8.8% (+17.2% constant currency) compared to the first
two months of 2022, and decreased by 20.5% (-19.3% constant currency) compared to the first two months of 2019.


地區
亞洲
本集團截至2022年12月31日止年度於亞洲的銷售淨額較截至2021年12月31日止年度增加228.9百萬美元或33.3%（按不
變匯率基準計算則增加43.9%）。經撇除本集團2022年及2021年第二季度、第三季度及第四季度中國的銷售淨額，本集團
截至2022年12月31日止年度於亞洲的銷售淨額較去年增加285.1百萬美元或55.8%（按不變匯率基準計算則增加68.5%）。
儘管中國收緊旅遊限制及社交距離措施，拖慢了2022年第二季度、第三季度及第四季度的銷售淨額的復甦步伐，但亞洲其
他國家的銷售淨額表現持續改善。

本集團截至2022年12月31日止年度於亞洲的銷售淨額較截至2019年12月31日止年度減少30.2%（按不變匯率基準計算則
減少25.0%）。經撇除本集團2022年及2019年第二季度、第三季度及第四季度中國的銷售淨額，本集團截至2022年12月
31日止年度於亞洲的銷售淨額較截至2019年12月31日止年度減少26.0%（按不變匯率基準計算則減少19.5%）。

本集團亞洲銷售淨額的表現於2023年首兩個月持續改善。2023年首兩個月的銷售淨額分別較2022年及2019年首兩個月增
加74.4%及3.2%（按不變匯率基準計算則增加85.9%及12.0%）。受中國以外亞洲市場旅遊業持續回升所推動，經撇除本集
團於2023年、2022年及2019年首兩個月中國的銷售淨額，2023年首兩個月的銷售淨額分別較2022年及2019年首兩個月
增加99.4%及10.0%（按不變匯率基準計算則增加112.1%及21.1%）。隨着中國政府終止新冠病毒清零政策，並放寬旅遊
及社交距離限制，本集團中國銷售淨額的表現亦有所改善。中國2023年首兩個月的銷售淨額較2022年首兩個月增加8.8%
（按不變匯率基準計算則增加17.2%），而較2019年首兩個月則減少20.5%（按不變匯率基準計算則減少19.3%）。

REGIONS
Europe
The Group’s net sales in Europe increased by US$256.6
million, or 61.2% (+87.7% constant currency), for the year       EUROPE
                                                                 歐洲
ended December 31, 2022, compared to the year ended
December 31, 2021. On March 14, 2022, the Group
suspended all commercial activities in Russia due to the
armed conflict in Ukraine, and the Group subsequently
completed the disposition of its Russian operations on July 1,
2022. When excluding the Russia Net Sales for the second
quarter of 2022 and the second, third and fourth quarters
of 2021, the Group’s net sales in Europe for the year ended
December 31, 2022, increased by US$288.2 million, or
74.8% (+103.6% constant currency), when compared to the
previous year.

The Group’s net sales declined by 14.7% (-0.8% constant
currency) in Europe during the year ended December 31,
2022, compared to the year ended December 31, 2019.
When excluding the Russia Net Sales for the second quarter
of 2022 and the second, third and fourth quarters of 2019,
the Group’s net sales in Europe for the year ended December
31, 2022, decreased by 9.1% but increased by 5.7% on a
constant currency basis when compared to the year ended
December 31, 2019.

The Group’s net sales performance in Europe continued to
improve during the first two months of 2023. Net sales for
the first two months of 2023 increased by 45.1% (+55.7%
constant currency) compared to the first two months of
2022, and decreased by 0.2% (+19.7% constant currency)
compared to the first two months of 2019. When excluding                                    American Tourister

 Notes 註釋
 (1) The geographic location of the Group’s net sales generally reflects the country from which its products were sold and does not necessarily
     indicate the country in which its end customers were actually located.
     本集團銷售淨額的地域位置分佈一般反映出售產品的國家，並不一定為終端客戶實際所在的國家。
 (2) Net sales in Belgium were US$21.2 million and US$10.1 million for the years ended December 31, 2022, and December 31, 2021,
     respectively, an increase of US$11.1 million, or 109.5% (+133.9% constant currency). Remaining sales consisted of direct shipments to
     distributors, customers and agents in other European countries, including e-commerce.
     截至2022年12月31日及2021年12月31日止年度，比利時的銷售淨額分別為21.2百萬美元及10.1百萬美元，增加11.1百萬美元或109.5%（按
     不變匯率基準計算則增加133.9%）。餘下的銷售額包括直接發貨予歐洲其他國家的分銷商、客戶及代理商（包括電子商貿）。
 (3) Net sales reported for the United Kingdom include net sales made in Ireland.
     英國呈報的銷售淨額包括於愛爾蘭錄得的銷售淨額。
 (4) On March 14, 2022, the Group suspended all commercial activities in Russia due to the armed conflict in Ukraine, and the Group
     subsequently completed the disposition of its Russian operations on July 1, 2022. When excluding the Russia Net Sales for the second
     quarter of 2022 and the second, third and fourth quarters of 2021, net sales in Europe increased by US$288.2 million, or 74.8% (+103.6%
     constant currency), for the year ended December 31, 2022, compared to the previous year.
     由於烏克蘭出現武裝衝突，本集團於2022年3月14日暫停在俄羅斯的所有商業活動，且本集團隨後於2022年7月1日完成出售其俄羅斯業務。
     經撇除於2022年第二季度及2021年第二季度、第三季度及第四季度的俄羅斯銷售淨額，截至2022年12月31日止年度歐洲的銷售淨額較去年
     增加288.2百萬美元或74.8%（按不變匯率基準計算則增加103.6%）。
 (5) Results stated on a constant currency basis, a non-IFRS measure, are calculated by applying the average exchange rate of the year under
     comparison to current year local currency results.
     按不變匯率基準計算呈列的業績為非IFRS財務計量工具，是以當地貨幣呈列的本年度業績採用與其相比較年度的平均匯率計算所得。

      Due to the impact of the COVID-19 pandemic, many lessees                       由於 2019 冠狀病毒疫症的影響，眾多

      and consequential accounting. The IASB has issued amendments                   會計處理。IASB已頒佈IFRS第16 號的

      The amendment became effective for annual reporting periods                    式。該修訂已於2020年6月1日或之後開

      are not required to assess whether eligible rent concessions are               的權宜之計，承租人無須評估合資格租

(c)   Goodwill and Other Intangible Assets Valuations                         (c)   商譽及其他無形資產估值
(i)   Goodwill Valuation                                                      (i)   商譽估值
      In accordance with IAS 36, the Group is required to evaluate its              根據IAS第36 號，本集團須至少每年評
      intangible assets with indefinite lives at least annually. The Group          估無限可用年期的無形資產。本集團審
      reviews the carrying amounts of its intangible assets with indefinite         閱無限可用年期的無形資產之賬面值，
      lives to determine whether there is any indication of impairment of           以釐定是否有任何減值跡象顯示現金產
      a CGU below its carrying value (resulting in an impairment charge).           生單位低於其賬面值（導致減值費用）。
      An impairment loss that has been recognized on goodwill is not                倘用於釐定可收回金額的估計出現變
      reversed in subsequent periods if estimates used to determine the             動，則於商譽中確認的減值虧損於隨後
      recoverable amount change.                                                    期間不予撥回。


      For the purpose of impairment testing, goodwill is allocated to               就減值測試而言，商譽獲分配至本集
      the Group’s operating segments, comprised of groups of CGUs,                  團的營運分部（由現金產生單位組別組
      as these represent the lowest level within the Group at which the             成），乃因該等現金產生單位組別代表本
      goodwill is monitored for internal management purposes. The                   集團就內部管理目的而監察商譽的最低
      allocation is made to those CGUs that are expected to benefit from            水平。商譽獲分配至預期受惠於產生商
      the business combination in which the goodwill arose.                         譽的業務合併事項的該等現金產生單位。


      As part of the annual evaluation process, separate calculations               作為年度估值程序的一部分，組成綜合
      are prepared for each of the groups of CGUs that make up the                  集團的各組現金產生單位單獨計算。該
      consolidated Group. These calculations used discounted cash flow              等計算基於管理層審閱的五年期（或如合
      projections based on financial estimates reviewed by management               理則更長期間）的財務估計，並使用貼
      covering a five-year period, or longer when justified, in order               現現金流量預測，以便於考慮最終價值

(d)   Exposure to Market Risk                                                  (d)   所承擔的市場風險
      Market risk is the risk that changes in market prices, such as foreign         市場風險為市場價格的變動風險，如影
      exchange rates, interest rates and equity prices will affect the               響本集團的收入或其持有金融工具價值
      Group’s income or the value of its holdings of financial instruments.          的匯率、利率及股權價格。市場風險管
      The objective of market risk management is to manage and                       理的目標為管理及控制市場風險程度於
      control market risk exposures within acceptable parameters, while              可接受參數之內，同時優化回報。
      optimizing the return.


      The Group periodically buys and sells financial derivatives, such              為管理市場風險，本集團定期購買及出
      as forward purchase contracts for hedging purposes, in order to                售金融衍生工具，例如就對沖訂立的遠
      manage market risks.                                                           期購買合約。

      respective functional currencies of the Group’s subsidiaries.                  貨幣風險。


      The Group periodically uses forward exchange contracts to hedge                本集團定期使用遠期外匯合約對沖其以
      its exposure to currency risk on product purchases denominated                 本集團附屬公司各自的功能貨幣以外的
      in a currency other than the respective functional currency of the             貨幣結算的產品採購的貨幣風險。該等
      Group’s subsidiaries. The forward exchange contracts typically                 遠期外匯合約的到期日一般少於一年。
      have maturities of less than one year.

      of the borrowing. Borrowings are generally denominated in                      算。借款一般以配合借款實體的相關營

      measurements involving significant unobservable inputs (Level 3                   量），以及涉及重大不可觀察輸入數據的
      measurements). The three levels of the fair value hierarchy are as                計量最低等級（第三級別計量）。公允價
      follows:                                                                          值等級架構的三個級別如下：


      •          Level 1 inputs are quoted prices (unadjusted) in active                •     第一級別輸入數據為本集團有能
                 markets for identical assets or liabilities that the Group has               力於計量日取得的相同資產或
